newsitem.title: DUBAI: Top U.S. military official meets Saudi King Fahd.
newsitem.headline: Top U.S. military official meets Saudi King Fahd.

text.p: The Chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff Army General John Shalikashvili held talks with Saudi Arabia's King Fahd, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said on Tuesday night.
SPA said Tuesday's meeting in Riyadh was also attended by Saudi Defence and Aviation Minister Prince Sultan as well as senior Saudi officials and U.S. diplomats.
It did not give further details of the general's visit to the kingdom where about 5,700 U.S. troops are stationed as part of coalition forces policing a "no-fly zone" over southern Iraq.
Shalikashvili arrived in Saudi Arabia from Egypt on the second leg of a Middle East tour which is also due to include Israel. The general is scheduled to return to the United States on January 10.
